name: Ritsumeikan University
description: Ritsumeikan University is a private university founded in 1900, with campuses in Kyoto, Shiga (Biwako-Kusatsu) and Osaka (Ibaraki). It is one of Japan's largest universities and teaches several undergraduate majors fully in English.
whyIncluded: Ritsumeikan University is among the 10 universities in Japan most chosen by international students (3,386 international students in May 2025, third in Japan, per JASSO), per the FinexisEdu shortlist research of October 2026.

programmes.name: College of International Relations, Global Studies Major (English-taught)
programmes.summary: Yearly tuition for students entering in 2027. The one-off ¥200,000 is the admission fee, paid once in year 1. Taught in English. Fees may be revised for inflation.
programmes.notes: English-taught undergraduate fees page, 'Tuition and Fee Figures for Students Enrolled in 2027': GS Major, April and September enrollment: first year ¥1,669,200 including the admission fee (¥734,600 per semester); 2nd year and beyond ¥734,600 per semester, ¥1,469,200 a year. Admission fee ¥200,000. Same tuition in years 2-4. The page says changes may be proposed if social factors such as rapid inflation have a significant impact, so not cohort-locked. No earlier-year table found.

programmes.name: College of Global Liberal Arts, RU-ANU Dual Degree (English-taught)
programmes.summary: Average yearly tuition for 2027 entrants to the dual degree with the Australian National University (higher after year 1). The one-off ¥200,000 is the admission fee. Taught in English.
programmes.notes: English-taught undergraduate fees page, 2027 enrollment, GLA RU-ANU Major: first year ¥2,600,000 including the ¥200,000 admission fee (¥1,200,000 per semester, i.e. tuition ¥2,400,000), 2nd year and beyond ¥1,434,000 per semester, ¥2,868,000 a year. 4-year total tuition ¥11,004,000, recorded as the 4-year average ¥2,751,000/yr. The council fee document lists Global Liberal Arts at ¥2,400,000-¥2,868,000. Not cohort-locked (fees may change with inflation). No earlier-year table found.
